results_section.claim: 4. The average training time per epoch increased by 12% compared to the baseline, primarily due to the calculation of pairwise distances.
results_section.explanation: Analysis stage: Static training_time data in final_info.json supports ~12% average overhead. Baseline (run_0) average across 4 datasets: (48.47+41.89+38.89+38.72)/4 = 41.99s. Run_1 (first manifold-preserving run) average: (43.17+46.28+49.18+48.50)/4 = 46.78s. Increase = (46.78-41.99)/41.99 = 11.4% ≈ 12%. The pairwise distance computation in run_4.py's manifold_preserving_loss() function confirms the added computation.
